title: BrAPI-Den Master Endpoint Registry
purpose: Canonical catalog identity and semantic metadata for published BrAPI v2.1 operations and proposed BrAPI-GenX operations. This registry does not prove runtime availability.
principles: OpenAPI route, method, request/response schemas, and documented responses remain authoritative for each wire contract.
A catalogId is a stable BrAPI-Den registry key. It does not replace an OpenAPI operationId.
For BrAPI v2.1 operations where the source specification has no operationId, operationIdInSource is null; recommendedOperationId is advisory only.
Proposed domain classification is a crosswalk, not an official BrAPI community reclassification.
BijMantra implementation/source evidence is tracked separately from standard contract status.
A semantic neighbor does not imply equivalence or safe dual-write behavior.

proposedDomainClasses.D7: Scientific Analysis, Models and Derived Evidence

entries.operationName: Get the Common Crop Names

classification.reason: Generic reference, people, or list resource is not assigned to a proposed scientific domain without further review.

entries.purpose: Get the Common Crop Names
entries.sourceDescription:
List the common crop names for the crops available in a database server. 

This call is ** required ** for multi-crop systems where data from multiple 
crops may be stored in the same database server. A distinct database server 
is defined by everything in the URL before "/brapi/v2", including host 
name and base path.

This call is recommended for single crop systems to be compatible with 
multi-crop clients. For a single crop system the response should contain 
an array with exactly 1 element. 

The common crop name can be used as a search parameter for Programs, 
Studies, and Germplasm.
